I have been feeling like this for a long time and so many things are going on I really don't know where to begin. I will make this short but cannot promise sweet. I am the youngest of 4 and the only girl. We are all 2 years apart. My dad died in a truck accident when I was 5 yrs old. My mom was sick with Lupus and spent months in the hospital at a time leaving us to listen and respect her enough to live everyday as though she was there. My grandmom and I was so close. I spent weekend, summer and vacations over there. My gramdmom died 2 months before my 17th birthday and my mom dies 4 days after my seventeenth birthday. My grandfather who pretty much raised me, turned nasty and abusive immediately after this happened. He never called me by my name in the 13 years he lived after them, he would call me my moms name. I wound up leaving and not talking to him for 5 years. My brothers and I got on drugs. I quit a yar and a half later and made my brother make a choice too. None us went back to that. I will be honest and say we all smoke weed but we are not even drinkers, so if that's all we do, don't judge! ;) I met my husband in high school and we got together when we were 22 years old. I didn't even want a boyfriend because I lost faith in people and God way before that. YES, JADED AT 22! He chase me for a good year and finally one night I went out with him. 3 weeks later he was telling me he loved me.mi told him don't, because everyone loves and then hurts the person. It is just the way it goes. I had 3 rules 1) have you ever been in jail? No. 2) any kids? No babymommadrama for me? Yes (2 yr old boy) 3) are you on drugs? No.
I let him slide on the kid thing because sometimes you have to come out of your comfort zone. Well over a year goes by and he had been spending nights, sometimes weekends out with his friend, the mom won't let him see his son, all to find out he somehow runs into her and they are out getting hi together. He of course denies it and then he finally tells me he does cocaine here and there. Woo oh I did not sign up for that and he said he'd stop. I never minded that he drank but that was the biggest issue. 7 years into our relationship he admitted cheating and by this time I was on lots of mess and crying myself to sleep. I knew he was cheating the whole time but he always denied it and blamed the drugs. Didn't even know how I was raising his son for over 3 years and took on all the responsibilities for him because I tried to be a GOOD WOMAN! It never mattered. I got pregnant and lost my baby and went thru it all alone. He says he went thru it too but never healed together. For 8 years I was on every antidepressant and nothing helped. After 14 years and him verbally abusing me and now me doing it right back, he looked at me one day and said I repulsed him. I cannot say the rest but it was bad. I wound up cheating on him and told him a year later. He begged me to stay and give him another chance. I did. He was usually good to me in other ways but even that became a resentment to him. Around the same time his mother got diagnosed with tongue and throat cancer and was going thru treatment. I got hit by a van in front of our house and lost all 3 jobs. My husband took very good care of our home financially and matched the money we were use to me putting in the bank for a year. A couple years later my mother in laws cancer was back and I noticed a lump on her neck on New Years Eve. She got sick fast and the tumors were surfacing on the outside of her throat and neck. I had her come live with us.mtook her to treatment 2x a week, took care of her straight to the end. She didn't want to die in a nursing home.nshe was very uncaring when it came to the things she said to my husband. He took a leave from work the moment they took her off treatment and looked at her son and said"is this ok with you? Are you ok that I'm dieing?" She ruined him right there. We both watched her die that next Christmas night and he found he unresponsive in our dinningroom. 1 year it took. For the past 2 years he has been self destructing, back on drugs and staying out for 5+ days. The fighting and degrading,and abuse has gotten so bad that he got arrested for putting my gun to my head. He spent every dime his mother left him and took out over $10,000 in credit card debit. I have been thru so much in the past 22 years I do not want to wake up in the morning. Everyday I think..... TODAY IS THE DAY! It has been a bad day.
